record.text: decided to give foldables another honest fair shake before iPhone Duo releases. so i have split my work phone—the Pixel 11 Pro Fold—into two halves w/ the Personal/Work separation features. it's not quite the same size, of course, but as close to it as i could get. i will report back on my findings!

I believe that even many skeptics who don’t yet understand why they would need iPhone Duo would change their minds and would be converted once they try it and clearly see all the ways how it can be useful. [4/4]

I believe that the iPhone Duo users will be constantly using it partially and fully unfolded, because the hardware form factor, sensors, and incredibly powerful, thoughtful, seamless, and frictionless software make it clear and obvious additional value compared to just using it folded. [3/4]

If you ever compared the iPad to an Android tablet, you know the vast difference in the user experience – and that’s the difference between the experience of using the iPhone Duo compared to an Android foldable, and then some. [2/4]

iPhone Duo invites and encourages you to open it frequently and to use it unfolded. It gives you so much more value when unfolded that the question of “why would I unfold it?” is answered thoroughly and convincingly. [1/4]
I can kiss and get my booty rubbed on too! Lemme go do some squats and get that iPhone Duo.

external.description: Looking back at past technology media articles reveals the vivid history of the iPhone's evolution from its debut to the present. While the original 2007 model was praised for its innovative usability and design, it also faced harsh criticism for missing features, slow networks, and a high price tag. Over time, Apple has announced a new foldable smartphone, the iPhone Duo, bringing fresh shock and expectations to the world. The high pricing and innovation of this new model mirror the situation surrounding the launch of the original iPhone back in 2007, serving as a valuable clue to understanding how cutting-edge technology is accepted and evolves in society.
